parameters.name: selector
parameters.typeAndMeaning: ASCII existing selector alphabet,1..128bytes

parameters.name: cohortScopeSHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: exact independently installed ordered legacy-two scope digest

parameters.name: provisioningGeneration
parameters.typeAndMeaning: ASCII opaque immutable installation generation,1..128bytes; never reset by reply

parameters.name: anchorVersion
parameters.typeAndMeaning: monotone positive integer <=2^53-1 inside protected generation

parameters.name: registrySPKIDER
parameters.typeAndMeaning: exact canonical Ed25519 public SPKI DER <=64KiB, independently provisioned

parameters.name: registrySPKISHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: SHA256(exact DER), compared to computed bytes; not a self-issued key identifier

parameters.name: registryKeyInterval
parameters.typeAndMeaning: original UTC signing interval, both issue and whole current read interval inside

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.typeAndMeaning: exact installed-policy-registry READ-SNAPSHOT only, no release/head/floor mutation

parameters.name: formatID
parameters.typeAndMeaning: fixed candidate ID, registration absent

parameters.name: formatSchemaSHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independent immutable candidate-envelope schema bytes

parameters.name: payloadSchemaSHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independent immutable source-specific policy payload schema bytes

parameters.name: projectionDomainAndDefinition
parameters.typeAndMeaning: exact fixed candidate domain,NUL,projection and stable-record identity definition

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.typeAndMeaning: Ed25519 fixed externally, no payload algorithm selection

parameters.name: bootstrapVerifierSourceSHA
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independently reviewed/installed source pin, actual NULL

parameters.name: bootstrapVerifierBinarySHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independently installed running bootstrap verifier artifact, actual NULL

parameters.name: bootstrapVerifierClosureSHA256
parameters.typeAndMeaning: source/dependency/link/stdlib/ABI closure, actual NULL

parameters.name: rootSourceChoiceAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: separately authenticated Root decision/publication identity and exact release/scope/coverage

parameters.name: providerAuthorization
parameters.typeAndMeaning: fixed repository,GitHub/origin,workflow/provider identity and bounded artifact acquisition policy

parameters.name: reviewerAuthorization
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independent exact review identity/key/purpose/scope and actual verdict/target/coverage rules

parameters.name: currentRegistryHeadAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: separate authenticated publication/head authority; snapshot signer cannot choose head

parameters.name: lifecycleAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: current unrevoked record/key/source/provider/reviewer/receipt status with stable record digest and version

parameters.name: clockAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: independent real UTC/monotonic mechanism and <=1second uncertainty bounds

parameters.name: readTicketAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: separate authenticated purpose/selector/scope/currentVersion request-binding issuer; K2A allocates none

parameters.name: runningInstallationAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: separate receipt and actual held process/executable measurement mechanism plus V1 recheck

parameters.name: antirollbackAuthority
parameters.typeAndMeaning: protected generation/key/record floors and independently reviewed advancement/recovery ownership

parameters.name: requiredCIPolicy
parameters.typeAndMeaning: exact disjoint required and optional step/run/job sets, never learned from provider green labels

parameters.name: byteAndOwnershipBounds
parameters.typeAndMeaning: capsule64KiB,envelope2MiB,policy16MiB,artifact256MiB streaming,expanded closure1GiB; private immutable snapshots
